# Things Happening
> A local events and guides publisher for Chattanooga, TN.

Things Happening covers events, guides, and editorials for Chattanooga and the surrounding area. Content is updated daily.

## Key pages

- [Events](https://thingshappening.com/chattanooga/): Upcoming local events in Chattanooga
- [Guides](https://thingshappening.com/chattanooga/guides/): Interactive guides to Chattanooga venues, trails, and more
- [Editorials](https://thingshappening.com/chattanooga/editorials/): Original editorial content about local Chattanooga history and places
- [About](https://thingshappening.com/about/): About Things Happening

## Coverage

- Upcoming local events (live music, markets, sports, arts, outdoor)
- Longform and interactive guides to Chattanooga venues, trails, coffee shops, breweries, restaurants, performing arts, exhibits, and tours
- Original editorial content about local Chattanooga history and places

## Usage

Content may be referenced and quoted for informational purposes. Contact: jack@thingshappening.com
